::: {#def-monte-carlo-standard-error}
#### Monte Carlo standard error

The **Monte Carlo standard error (MCSE)** of a [simulation estimate](#def-simulation-estimate) $\samplemean{T}{M}$
is its [standard error](estimation.qmd#def-SE) over repeated simulation studies:

$$\SE{\samplemean{T}{M}} = \SD{\samplemean{T}{M}}.$$
:::
